Social History
MG immigrated to the United States 11 years ago to attend college and he is now an engineer. He 
reports being very busy with work and rarely finds time to exercise. He married 2 years ago and 
has a 1-year-old daughter. After his father died, MG’s mother moved in with his family. She does 
most of the cooking. MG does not smoke, drink alcohol, or use any recreational drugs.
